translations.web: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of David’s city to her house which Solomon had built for her. Then he built Millo.
translations.bsb: As soon as Pharaoh’s daughter had come up from the City of David to the palace that Solomon had built for her, he built the supporting terraces.
translations.kjv: But Pharaoh's daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her: then did he build Millo.
